description: Scout's detour offers on the connected person's drives today, as the Scout page shows them: the streak line (how many drives or weeks straight home), the offer (worth it: an event they marked interest in, near a drive, as a stop; dodge it: a big crowd a drive passes, with the way around), the DETOUR-XXX code and what the code opens. The route's own state never changes because of an event. Use for 'any detours today', 'what is that DETOUR code', 'anything worth stopping for on the way home'. Empty when there is no offer. Needs a connected account.
name: my_detours
title: Scout's detours for today
